annotations.title: Check data against green, yellow, and red rules

description: Classify a task or a description of the data against the template's green, yellow, and red rules for PII and PHI. Returns green (allowed in an approved tool), yellow (mask individual identifiers first), or red (do not enter), with the rule that matched. Rules guidance only, not legal advice. The description is not stored.

description.description: What the task is, or what kind of data is involved. Do not paste Social Security numbers, diagnoses, account numbers, or passwords.
